title: E is for EFB: The ONLY guide you need for MSFS 2024 & FBW
description:
In Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, the simulation doesn't start on the runway; it starts in the palm of your hand. The new integrated Electronic Flight Bag (EFB) is a game-changer that bridges the gap between the World Map and your cockpit. But for those flying the legendary FlyByWire A32nx, you actually have two powerful tablets at your disposal. 

In this episode of our MSFS series, we will first walk you through the standard menu's. These walkthroughs are going a level deeper then you might expect from a walkthrough, we will discuss almost every details and abbreviation we encounter and how this applies to MSFS 2024. Of course we spend the most time on the flight planner option in the MSFS 2024 EFB because this is where it all happens: from planning a flight, calculating performance settings and more. As a bonus we will look at several community and developer add-ins for the EFB. Once we finished the MSFS 2024 EFB we will compare it with FBW's. For this one the integration with SimBrief is super powerful and makes flight planning a lot easier. Besides this this EFB has a lot of other interesting options which are missing from the default EFB and we will look at them one-by-one.
